domain: urban transit operations - next-day station-pair rail ridership exceedance for the Klang Valley Rapid Rail network (LRT Kelana Jaya, LRT Ampang/Sri Petaling, Monorail, MRT Kajang, MRT Putrajaya), from anonymous tap-in/tap-out gate transactions published daily by the Malaysian national open-data platform

jurisdiction.publisher: data.gov.my (Jabatan Digital Negara / Ministry of Digital platform); data supplied by Prasarana Malaysia Berhad (Rapid Rail) via the Ministry of Transport

prediction_question: At 07:00 Asia/Kuala_Lumpur on operating day T, using only the published origin-destination ridership history dated T-2 and earlier (the publication lag is one day, so day T-1's rows are not yet available at the instant - measured, see prediction_time), predict whether a given station-pair's ridership on day T (00:00-23:59 local) will exceed a fixed reference threshold for that pair. A useful prediction supports Rapid Rail's operational planning at the day-ahead horizon: train frequency, staff/crowd-control deployment at interchange stations, and event-day capacity decisions for the ~1M daily trips on the network.
prediction_time: 07:00 Asia/Kuala_Lumpur on target day T, before the operating day begins. Every feature is a ridership row dated <= T-2, taken from the frozen annual edition (completed years) or the pinned current-year snapshot; all four source columns (origin, destination, date, ridership) are individually documented by the publisher (dataset page 'fields' metadata, measured 2026-11-07), and no undocumented column is used. Publication calendar is the publisher's own: the dataset page carries data_as_of 2026-11-06 23:59, last_updated 2026-11-07 16:03, next_update 2026-11-08 22:00, and the storage file rapidrail_2026_daily.csv (Content-Length 318,772,855) was last modified 2026-11-07 08:03:16 GMT with its last data row dated 2026-11-06 - a measured one-day publication lag. Frozen annual editions 2023 (374,488,341 B, Last-Modified 2026-09-21), 2024 (375,944,306 B, 2026-09-23), 2025 (309,579,953 B, 2026-04-02) pin the completed years; the 2026 edition updates daily and must be digest-pinned at build. Calendar features (day-of-week, month, elapsed-day) are available at any instant. This is a current-compilation retrospective: per-row historical vintages are not published, and no operational point-in-time reproducibility of past values is claimed - the same posture as ab-wildfire-ia-escape, to be stated in quality.json.evaluation_contract.
target_definition: Binary label per (origin, destination, day T): pair ridership on day T >= a fixed pair-specific reference threshold (construction selects: per-pair training-window percentile, e.g. p90, or a small set of absolute thresholds; candidate thresholds recorded from measured pair-year series in probe/pair_blocks_2024.json). Source column: 'ridership' (integer trips, publisher-documented as trips not necessarily passengers); it is the label source and is excludable from shipped features (shipped features are the SAME column's values at dates <= T-2 plus calendar - the label is its day-T value, which postdates the instant). Population: all ordered station pairs on the network with an active block in the source, excluding (a) rows with origin or destination 'A0: All Stations' (pseudo-station aggregate/censored rows, measured station-scale magnitudes ~4.4k/day, semantics to be verified against pair sums at construction), and (b) pairs whose destination is a Putrajaya Line station other than PYL03/PYL04 (32/34 PYL station codes never appear as destinations - confirmed by my own 2024-edition sampling AND by a public data-request thread id 216 dated 2026-10-24; censoring, not zero demand). Zero-ridership days are published as rows with value 0 (29.3% of pair rows on a sampled Saturday), so observed absence is distinguishable from missing data.

measurements.probe_scripts: candidates/my-rapidrail-od-exceedance/probe/: edition_head_inventory_2026_11_07.py (HEAD all editions - sizes, Last-Modified), edition_head_tail_2026_11_07.py (header + head/tail rows per edition), range_sample_2026_11_07.py (bounded ~1.5 MB Range samples per CSV), extract_pair_blocks_2026_11_07.py (complete pair-year series via block binary search; output pair_blocks_2024.json), dump_catalogue_2026_11_07.py (full platform catalogue enumeration; inventory in references/catalogue_inventory_2026-11-07.txt). All commands and outputs are reproduced in notes.md.
measurements.platform_catalogue: data.gov.my is a Next.js platform (not CKAN): /api/3/action 404; the documented Open API is api.data.gov.my (developer.data.gov.my). Catalogue enumeration via the data-catalogue page's __NEXT_DATA__: 355 dataset slugs on the catalogue page; full inventory retained in references/catalogue_inventory_2026-11-07.txt. The platform is overwhelmingly DOSM aggregate time series; the event-derived panels are the ridership OD sets (rapidrail daily, komuter hourly, ktmb services, brt), PriceCatcher (already published), a COVID-19 death line-list (closed coverage, saturated literature) and NPRA product registers (snapshots, no history).
measurements.panel_structure: Columns: origin,destination,date,ridership (2024 CSV header measured). File sorted (origin, destination, date) - measured: a 1.7 MB window at offset ~50.3 MB contains 27,821 rows spanning exactly one origin's block boundary (12,621 rows of dates 2024-01-01..06-14 for the preceding origin + 76 rows dated 2024-06-15 + 15,124 rows of dates 2024-06-16..12-31), i.e. contiguous pair blocks each carrying a full year of rows. Station codes are line-specific and self-describing (e.g. 'KG16: Pasar Seni', 'KJ14: Pasar Seni' are the same physical interchange station on different lines; line prefix: AG Ampang, KG Sri Petaling, KJ Kelana Jaya, MR Monorail, SP MRT Kajang, PYL MRT Putrajaya).
measurements.pair_year_series_2024: Five complete pair-year series extracted (366/366 days, 0 missing dates, 0 zero-days for these active pairs): A0->AG01 (pseudo-station row, p50 4,374, weekday ~4,400 vs Sat 3,032/Sun 2,653, Eid 2024-04-10/11 dip to 1,854/2,013); KG16->KJ14 CBD interchange (p50 90, weekend INVERTED: Sat 120 vs Mon 76); KJ14->KG16 (p50 95, similar inversion); SP31->SP31 self-pair (p50 104, flat weekdays, 2024-05-23 spike 332); PYL33->KG16 low-demand pair (p50 13, flat). Full series in probe/pair_blocks_2024.json. Shows strong pair-type heterogeneity (commuter vs leisure vs low-demand), holiday signal (Eid al-Fitr), and weekday/weekend structure a solution must capture; pair-relative thresholds avoid collapsing this heterogeneity into one absolute scale.
measurements.provenance_mix: 'A0: All Stations' pseudo-station rows appear as BOTH origin (file head: 'A0: All Stations,AG01: Sentul Timur,...') and destination ('KG06: Kota Damansara,A0: All Stations,2024-06-15,2702'), at station-scale magnitudes (not pair-scale). They must be excluded from the pair panel; whether they are aggregate totals or unknown-tap censored rows is a construction-time verification against station sums (recorded as an open check, not an assumption). PYL05+ destinations are censored (see target_definition); PYL origins are present.
measurements.coverage_and_editions: Editions 2023-2026 exist; 2023/2024/2025 frozen (Last-Modified 2026-09-21 / 2026-09-23 / 2026-04-02), 2026 current-year updated daily (2026-11-07 08:03, data through 2026-11-06). The 2023/2024/2025 editions were (re)generated in 2026 - they are the publisher's current published form of completed years, not archival vintages; the task claims no operational historical availability (current-compilation retrospective). 2024 contains all 366 dates (sampled); the 2026 tail extends through 2026-11-06.
measurements.extraction_cost_measured: Storage HEAD/Range probes from the coordinator vantage (2026-11-07): complete pair-year series for 5 pairs = 150 HTTP requests, 744,161 bytes fetched, 86.0 s wall (Python 3.14 stdlib, urllib); bounded 6-chunk Range samples = 1.5 MB per file. Construction inputs are the four parquet editions (5.37-6.10 MB each, ~22.7 MB total) - a trivial worker download; CSVs (310-376 MB/year) are unnecessary when parquet is used. No auth, no rate-limit hit, no bulk transfer through the coordinator.
measurements.novelty_search_scope: Web searches 2026-11-07: 'Klang Valley Rapid Rail origin-destination ridership dataset machine learning benchmark prediction' and 'metro origin-destination passenger flow prediction benchmark dataset public transit exceedance classification'. Found: SHMetro/HZMetro and SHMOD/HZMOD benchmarks (Shanghai/Hangzhou, 15-minute inflow/OD regression, researcher-hosted, 2016/2019 snapshots), MTA Subway OD Ridership (monthly-average hourly OD, data.ny.gov), Nanjing/Beijing/Guangzhou/Shenzhen literature datasets (private or per-paper). No public ML-ready benchmark or scored task for any Klang Valley rail dataset; a UNITEN thesis used SNA on a 120-node/5,567-edge travel-history dataset (not public, not a prediction benchmark).

split_strategy: Temporal, disjoint by calendar year of the TARGET day (Asia/Kuala_Lumpur): train 2023-01-01..2024-12-31 (frozen editions), eval 2025-01-01..2025-12-31 (frozen edition), holdout 2026-01-01..build-date (current-year file digest-pinned at build; the publisher's own frozen 2026 edition, due ~early 2027 by the observed 2025 pattern, is the durable re-verification target). Panel scale (measured, not full-counted): ~5.4M pair-day rows per year (2024 CSV 375,944,306 B at ~70 B/row; ~14-17k pair-rows per day sampled), so each window carries orders of magnitude more rows and positives than the bench needs at any candidate threshold. Full split counts (rows, pairs, positives at the chosen thresholds, day-clustered positive counts) are the FIRST construction step on the worker - sampled counts are never presented as full counts (same convention as datasus-sinasc-cesarean-share-decline). Positives cluster by day (network-wide events lift many pairs); clustered counts must be computed and recorded before any score is interpreted.

novelty_check.ours: First public ML-ready benchmark task for Klang Valley rail: day-ahead station-pair ridership exceedance (binary, temporal splits, evaluation contract) built from Prasarana tap-in/tap-out OD panels on the maintained national open-data platform; new task family for the bench (urban transit demand) and new geography; publication cadence, frozen annual editions and censoring handled by a stated contract.
novelty_check.rule: A dataset that already exists in ML-ready form is not published. Mirroring is a failure mode, not a contribution.
